title: Reel Fishing Overhaul
description: A simple datapack that changes fishing so the actual fish appears when you catch a fish instead of the item.
body: All this datapack does is replace the Cod, Salmon, Tropical Fish, and Pufferfish items you get from fishing with their actual fish models instead of the normal items. This might make fishing feel more visual and immersive, or more annoying and time consuming depending on your preference. :)
